  • Method Details

    • createFollower

      MotorController createFollower(String logPrefix, int deviceID, boolean isInvertedFromLeader) throws MotorConfigException
      Creates a new motor controller that is configured to follow this motor controller.
      Parameters:
      logPrefix - The prefix for the log entries.
      deviceID - The device ID of the new motor controller.
      isInvertedFromLeader - Whether the new motor controller should be inverted in direction from this motor controller. This is useful for when the follower is mechanically connected to the leader but must spin in the opposite direction.
      Returns:
      A new motor controller that is configured to follow this motor controller.
      Throws:
      MotorConfigException - If the follower motor controller cannot be created or configured for any reason.
